answer: A opal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mirror of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing.
